This means that the 6.6.0 fix for the RedirectHandler open redirect (CVE-2026-116578, commit cc75ab0e) is incomplete. articles.title: GHSA: Nuxt: Incomplete fix for GHSA-9v7c-q64q-vv33: a leading `//` in the request path bypasses `server/middleware` path checks and server route rules on page routes
articles.summary:
### Summary

Since `4.6.0`, Nuxt parses a request path that starts with `//` as a URL with a host before rendering a page, so `//x/admin` renders the page at `/admin`. Nitro's routing, Nitro's route rules and `server/middleware` see the path as `//x/admin`, so server-side checks keyed on `/admin` do not apply.
